samples=[]; errors=0; total=0\ndef one(_):\n global errors,total\n t=time.perf_counter()\n try:\n  with urllib.request.urlopen(URL,timeout=5) as r:\n   code=r.status; r.read()\n  ok=200<=code<300\n except Exception:\n  ok=False\n  code=0\n dt=(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000\n with lock:\n  total+=1; errors+=not ok; samples.append((time.time(),dt,code))\n return ok\nstart=time.time()\nwith concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=CONCURRENCY) as ex:\n while time.time()-start < DURATION:\n  list(ex.map(one,range(CONCURRENCY)))\nend=time.time()\nvals=[x[1] for x in samples]; vals.sort()\ndef pct(p): return vals[min(len(vals)-1,max(0,int(len(vals)*p)-1))] if vals else None\nprint(json.dumps({'duration_s':end-start,'total':total,'errors':errors,'successes':total-errors,'rps':total/(end-start),'p50_ms':pct(.50),'p95_ms':pct(.95),'p99_ms':pct(.99),'status_codes':{str(c):sum(1 for x in samples if x[2]==c) for c in sorted(set(x[2] for x in samples))}},sort_keys=True))\nPY\nBEFORE=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | sort);
